reply_text:
I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is at **382 seats**. Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing later in the channel changes it. Hollis is a member of the channel, and a seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it there is fine.

The gbrain knowledge base couldn't help: it refused the search and read nothing. Its connection isn't tied to any member, and it serves several people. That means I only checked #central-team, not any other records. Fixing it needs someone with access to the server that hosts gbrain, who can bind the connection to a member with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
